quest.title: Rite of the Bold
quest.description: Go to the Children of Echoes and search for clues concerning the Volcanic Token.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000

talks.objective: Go near the Stadium of the Sacred Flame

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Need to prep for a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Manqu
dialogues.text: Of course. I'll tell him once you're ready...

talks.objective: Go to the Children of Echoes

dialogues.speaker: Manqu
dialogues.text: ...Is there any room to negotiate?

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: Manqu, look at me. Didn't you hear what Titu said? No one's attempted this feat in almost 500 years.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: Even if you claim that you've found a possible entrance...

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: Well, so what? You listen well — no human or Saurian companion setting out on this road has ever returned. Not a single one.

dialogues.speaker: Manqu
dialogues.text: Um, forgive my directness, but...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, there's our Relics Association guy. And that over there... Is that the chief of the tribe?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Relics Guy!

dialogues.speaker: Manqu
dialogues.text: #Ah, it's you, {NICKNAME}... Paimon, and {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: Huh, a Tepetlisaur with a red tail scarf! Mighty energetic, and looks different right off the bat too! Alright, little fella, give us another!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Raaawr!

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: #Not bad! So you're {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? And I suppose that makes you two the ones it chose...

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: #And haven't you two been the talk of the town lately, {NICKNAME}, Paimon? Manqu here's been mumbling about you constantly, and Titu mentioned you after his return.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: It wouldn't be a stretch to call your recent deeds "legendary," and you've been a friend to us Children of Echoes thus far.

choices.text: There's no need to thank me too much.

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: Haha, quite the phenomenal youngster!

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: And it is in that capacity, Manqu, that I'm telling you — it is not our way to push guests into a fiery pit just to prove a hypothesis.

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: That's not how "I'd" treat my guests, anyway.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: *sigh*...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's all this about, anyway? Something about danger, and a fiery pit?

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Apologies. Allow me to explain...

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Remember what we spoke of before? To remove the mark of the Flamelord's Blessing, you need to bring the two required token types to the volcano.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: One of the tokens is in the ruins beyond the Children of Echoes' land...

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: There are conditions for getting in, though.

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: Based on past custom... Which I only just found on a woven scroll, by the way, since it's been ages since anyone's hankered to try this.

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: If you wish to take your Saurian companion to the volcano and perform a baptism to cleanse the Flamelord's Blessing, you must be recognized by said Saurian's corresponding tribal chief...

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: #With {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} being a Tepetlisaurus, this means the chief of the Children of Echoes.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Isn't that you?

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: #Well, yeah, though I'll be real, I don't know if this rule applies to outsiders. Still, {NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: For hundreds of years, many are those who have tried to free their Saurian companions from what runs in their bloodline... this thing that is more curse than blessing.

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: But not a single one has succeeded... Which is why the tribes gradually abandoned the custom...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A zero percent success rate, seriously!?

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: Yes, so perilous is the journey. It's also said that the trial that must be passed before one may obtain the token will test not only the warrior who steps forth, but also the Saurian with them...

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: You are not of the tribes, but I will not have you die in vain.

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: #So please, {NICKNAME}, I suggest that you leave {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} here with us.

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: If nothing else, I can ensure it will be taken care of until the day it must enter the Night Kingdom.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But... If we do that...

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: #...As I said, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} will be unable to grow up.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Roar...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Looks like that's not what it wants.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'll try this all the same.

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: Despite the immense peril?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yes.

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: And what about you, little fella?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: Hahaha! Unyielding, resolute, yet passionate. Your hearts blaze like fine phlogiston.

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: Alright then. Then I shall award you the right to embark on the volcanic pilgrimage.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright! Let's go get that first token, then!

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: No, not yet. Now that you are qualified, you must undertake a trial of witnesses...

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Ancient custom dictates that the warrior and Saurian must together obtain the feather of a green quetzal deep in the woods, and offer up a stole of animal pelts...

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: And together, you must win fifty battles for our tribe, and offer up ninety-six gems of high quality...

choices.text: Uh, I wouldn't be eligible to...

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: Oh come now, Manqu, forget it. Where are those traditions even from? Some lost stone age?

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: The purpose of those formalities was to foster the bond between human and Saurian, and hone their skills — and I've had it with all that.

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: #Anyway, as I see it, neither {NICKNAME} nor {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} seems to need that sort of proof.

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: #To put things simply, {NICKNAME}, we have here in Natlan a super simple way of dealing with such situations...

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: Fight me, and prove your strength!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Right on!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait? Here? Oh, do you mean we're going on stage?

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: Of course not, haha, the stage isn't a place for tunneling... Our duel grounds are in the mountain to the rear.

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: Come, let's head there — we'll have ourselves a good one!

choices.text: Can you give me a discount on those for Mora?

dialogues.speaker: Manqu
dialogues.text: Again, forgive my directness... But while I am aware of your strength, be careful all the same.

dialogues.speaker: Manqu
dialogues.text: He obtained no Ancient Name, but Pacal is not to be taken lightly... so long as he's kept his training up these last few years.

dialogues.speaker: Manqu
dialogues.text: If you're ready, then we can begin.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're ready!

dialogues.speaker: Manqu
dialogues.text: In that case, on your marks. The duel will soon begin.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, nice! We won! Great job us!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: Hah... Hoo. I'm not sure even the best warrior in our tribe could take you out... That was a sound defeat indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: Whaddya think, huh, buddy? Looks like we need more training!

dialogues.speaker: Uchu
dialogues.text: Mmmm...

dialogues.speaker: Manqu
dialogues.text: Quite a spectacular battle, indeed...

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: Pretty words, Manqu, but is that all you've got? Wanna try your hand too?

dialogues.speaker: Manqu
dialogues.text: No, thank you very much.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: #Bleh. Boring. Ah, that was a great match! {NICKNAME}... You're the real deal.

choices.text: I was just warming up, you know...

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: Hahaha! Cocky, too! Still, I admire that. The strong should also assert their dominance a bit! I mean, what's the point of getting strong otherwise?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: #Haha, looks like you really are well taken care of, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Of course! {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}'s our trusty buddy, y'know!

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: I am very glad to hear that.

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: As promised, this is proof of your accomplishment from a tribal chief.

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: As for its official name — well, Manqu, there's your cue...

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: The Talisman of Waxaklahun Ubah Kan... the Sage of the Stolen Flame.

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: Yeah, I can never memorize that name, but I do remember that after the Pyro Dragon Sovereign's death, and after the first Pyro Archon was revived from the flames...

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: The Sage and the Archon each brought back one token from the volcano, and whomsoever obtains both may enter the cleansing fire within the volcano and purge all curses and calamities.

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: Still, how long did this Sage live anyway, Manqu? I feel like there are tales of him from the tribal era to that of Ochkanatlan...

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: ...And even around the Shadow Pin.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Well, he was the first human to use phlogiston... and who knows what fate came upon such legendary figures?

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Some say both his body and spirit turned into phlogiston, becoming one with Natlan's winds, lands, and flowers, granting him the power to hear the prayers for help directed at him by all the tribes.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Some say that each era boasted its own successor to the sagely title, passing it on even to this day.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: But — and excuse my bluntness — these are mostly storytellers' speculations.

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: Haha, watch yourself with those words. You'll make Titu mad again.

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: Alright. My duties are hereby discharged— oh, wait, tradition does demand one more thing...

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: Which is to grant the brave journeying soul and their companions my blessing.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Hmm?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, so that's also a ritual you all do, huh?

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: Heh, it's just moral support. Don't get your hopes up, eh?

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: #Right, then. {NICKNAME}, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Here I am, chief.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: May you soar through the mountains like the hardiest bird;\nMay the wicked tides break upon you as if you were the hardest of stones.

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: May you fear no hardship, for the world is bound to be full of it.\nMay you never forget each other, for fate must bring an inevitable farewell.

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: May you reach your destination and gain what you desire... And most of all, I hope that you shall safely return.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I will.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Wait, does Paimon get any blessings?

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: Haha! As for you, little Paimon... May you eat and drink well, sleep sumptuously, and see goodly growth!

choices.text: That sounds pretty good to me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, Paimon accepts this blessing — but only just, okay?

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: Fine by me. In that case, the rite of witnesses is ended. But before you go, let me stress this again: be careful.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We know, Pacal. See ya! ... And seeya too, Uchu!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Roar!

response.speaker: Uchu
response.text: Roar...

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: Good luck. See you all soon.

choices.text: Can you even grow, goodly or otherwise, Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Of course! Just you wait, Paimon's gonna be as big as three mountains before you know it!

response.speaker: Pacal
response.text: Hahaha, save the commiseration. Now, if I was younger, who knows how that might have gone? Ah, how I wish I could have taken you on then.

dialogues.speaker: Manqu
dialogues.text: Well, now that we have some proof, we may go forth and obtain the token left by the Sage of the Stolen Flame.

dialogues.speaker: Manqu
dialogues.text: The ruin's entrance isn't far. If I may be so bold, please proceed to the ruins near the Children of Echoes...

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: Seeking to enter the volcano with only the strength you now possess... it's a bit too much to hope for.
